sources.title: Contact | North Central News
sources.notes: Official contact page confirms North Central News at 1645 E. Missouri Ave., Ste 450, Phoenix, AZ 85016, phone (602) 277-2742, fax (602) 277-6689, admin/editorial/advertising contacts, monthly publication status, and circulation described as 22,000 mailed copies plus 5,000 rack-distributed copies.

sources.title: North Central News, Inc. | Greater Phoenix Chamber
sources.notes: Chamber listing confirms the same address and phone, lists categories Newspaper, Publishers, and Advertising and Marketing, and says the paper covers issues, events, and people in North Central Phoenix with 26,000 copies distributed monthly in the area.

sources.title: North Central News Advertising Rates 2023
sources.notes: Official rate-card PDF confirms advertising focus, address, phone, fax, advertising email, distribution geography from Thunderbird Road to Indian School Road and 44th Street to 19th Avenue, and 2023 circulation detail of 21,000 mailed copies plus 4,000 rack-distributed copies. Treat rates/circulation on this older PDF as historical unless updated by the publisher.

content_warnings: The local top-level category 'Beauty And Wellness' is not supported by sources; sourced reality is local media, publishing, and advertising.
Do not write salon, wellness, appointment-care, or personal-care copy for this business.

Circulation figures vary by source and date: official contact page says 22,000 mailed plus 5,000 racks; Chamber says 26,000 monthly; 2023 rate card says 21,000 mailed plus 4,000 racks. Use cautious wording or verify with the publisher before publishing exact circulation claims.
Advertising pricing should not be copied from the 2023 rate card without confirming current rates.
